description: WHM in-product survey metadata. Returned URLs may contain private tokens and are never fetched by the client.

notes.text: Available in cPanel and WHM 86 and later. Returns whether to display the survey banner and its link. The source declares x-readonly=false. display and new_user use the existing public integer 0|1 flag convention: exact quoted 0/1 source values normalize to integers and native 0/1 flags are accepted. max_dismiss remains a string, and user_type is the documented whm string. Other strings, integers, booleans and fractions are not accepted for the two flags. Response fields retain optional presence. Returned links can contain private tokens; treat them as payload data and never fetch them automatically.
Client policy: send one request without automatic retry or rollback. Optional null arguments are omitted; accepted explicit zero and empty strings retain their supplied values.
